summary: Transocean filed an 8-K updating its pending acquisition of Valaris, announced February 9, 2026, under a Business Combination Agreement. Transocean will acquire all outstanding Valaris common shares for 15.235 Transocean shares per Valaris share, an all-stock deal with no cash consideration stated. On September 30, 2026, the parties received DOJ Antitrust Division notice closing the HSR Act investigation, and the HSR waiting period has expired. Closing is anticipated in Q4 2026, subject to remaining conditions. Watch regulatory clearances outside the US, shareholder approvals, and any renegotiation risk given the fixed exchange ratio.
